Для измерения интенсивности подключите к: To measure intensity, connect a resistor to the photoelement and measure the voltage across it with a multimeter; this voltage will indicate the intensity.
Для проверки линейности (пропорционально: To check linearity (proportionality between light intensity and photometer reading), a source whose intensity can be changed by a known factor is required.
Интенсивность света можно изменять в одн: The light intensity can be changed by the same factor using identical filters. You have five identical filters (gray films) at your disposal.
Используйте пластилин и скотч в качестве: Use modeling clay and tape as fasteners.
Калькулятор прикройте черной дискетой, т: Cover the calculator with a black diskette so that its hole aligns with the photoelement; this ring will also help you adjust the setup.
Не всегда под рукой может оказаться изме: A light intensity meter may not always be at hand. No problem — once again, Belarusian Olympiads use a photoelement from a common Chinese calculator. You are to check its operability and use it to study the dependence of reflected light intensity on the angle of incidence.
Одна из главных проблем оптических датчи: One of the main problems of optical sensors (besides low sensitivity) is nonlinearity, when the readings are not proportional to the intensity of the incident light. In this part of the work, you need to investigate this property of the photodetector.
Оптические приборы (особенно отражающие: Optical instruments (especially reflective surfaces) require cleanliness; try not to touch them with your fingers, and wipe them occasionally with a cloth.
